document:5:518:0.text:
Ingredients: <style="highlight">black tea</style>, <style="highlight">glimmerbloom leaves</style>, <style="highlight">laurel flowers</style>, and <style="highlight">honey</style>.
Instructions: Pour water into a pot and add the <style="highlight">laurel flowers</style>. Bring to a boil, then add <style="highlight">black tea</style> and <style="highlight">glimmerbloom leaves</style>. Once the mixture has cooled slightly, stir in a generous amount of <style="highlight">honey</style>.
document:5:518:0.source_cn:
材料：<style="highlight">红茶</style>基底；<style="highlight">荧荧花叶</style>；<style="highlight">月桂花</style>；<style="highlight">蜂蜜</style>。
调配方法：准备纯净水，放入<style="highlight">月桂花</style>。小火煮开后，依次放入<style="highlight">红茶</style>、<style="highlight">荧荧花叶</style>。稍稍冷却后，放入足量的<style="highlight">蜂蜜</style>。
